observations.what: National Assembly election, 3 April 2022, results application
observations.finding: Shows a data-update timestamp (16 April 2022), the composition of the National Assembly with a total of 199 seats, national party-list and nationality-list results (votes, shares, list mandates), and single-member district results with candidate names. Joint lists are displayed as one contestant with several member organisations. No download link, file export, licence or terms-of-use text is shown; the page links its Impresszum, data-protection notice and public-interest data pages on www.valasztas.hu.

reuse_right.basis: The terms are linked from the results application to www.valasztas.hu/impresszum, which is robots-blocked; no permission is inferred from the public nature of election results.

acquisition_route.basis: vtr.valasztas.hu is a JavaScript application without a visible export; www.valasztas.hu is robots-blocked. Undocumented application endpoints are not used (no hidden-endpoint discovery).

source_files_complete.basis: No machine-readable official file is located for any election.

national_definition_complete.basis: The national party-list vote is the comparable tier (single-member district, nationality and surplus votes are separate tiers). 199 seats from 2014 is visible in the 2022 application; the 386-seat two-round system of 2002–2010 is not yet documented from an official source.

same_election_identity_complete.basis: Joint lists (for example the 2022 Fidesz–KDNP list and the 2022 six-party joint list) are election-specific contestants, distinct from their member parties; member composition must come from the official list registration, which is not yet located. Nationality lists and the preferential nationality mandate are separate contestant kinds.

electoral_system_metadata_complete.basis: Thresholds (5% / 10% / 15%) and allocation rules are background only (Act CCIII of 2011); the official legal text has not been reviewed from a registered host.

vintage_decisions_complete.basis: The application shows a data-update timestamp; how it relates to the final certified NVB result is not documented.
